content_lock.speaker_notes: Explain the variable-N frequency-band construction: band-pass filtering produces B1, B2, B3, …, BN subgraphs, which are connected into the Total graph. Four visible band examples are shown for layout only; N is not fixed to four. Total graph feeds Input. The 12-node input glyph is a four-row-by-three-column schematic with eight solid within-row links; dashed cross-band and inter-row links are illustrative only, with no exact count or numerical adjacency asserted. The three-node motifs used for each displayed B_i and Total graph layer are a visual-consistency choice, not recovered topology. Input follows both the direct GCN path and the Input → Energy-assisted module → first GCN branch. The first pooling layer branches to a second readout; both readouts converge at summation before Dense. The five output squares are an illustrative five-class example; actual class count may vary, and only C2 is highlighted. Preserve the author-lab visible IR labels and disclose that the public abstract uses SR; this terminology discrepancy remains unresolved.
